Taj Palace, New Delhi — bespoke decorative objects (2018).

A set of bespoke objects and tabletop for the palace hotel: concrete-and-brass candle holders, a woven peacock panel, lidded ceramic jars, brass candelabra and crafted accents. The small, considered things that furnish a grand room.

Bespoke decor & tabletop — Anirudh Kapoor. A·59.
